name: LiquidChrome-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Bright chrome blades curl around deep black pools, showing the metallic swirl across the whole frame.

tagline: Black and silver liquid chrome curls into glossy ribbons.
summary: A full-bleed surface of molten chrome: white metallic ribbons twist through pools of black, with sharp specular highlights. The liquid keeps folding and the pointer stirs a local ripple.
appearance: High-contrast swirls of pure white and near-black, with narrow grey transitions that read as polished metal. Bands fold into hooks and loops, and the brightest edges look like reflected light on a curved surface.
behaviour: The metal flows and folds continuously, dragging highlights along as it goes. Moving the pointer stirs a soft ring-shaped ripple at the cursor while the rest keeps churning.
use_when: A product page wants an abstract metal surface that feels premium behind minimal text.
avoid_when: You need colour or calm: the surface is strictly grey and constantly moving.
customise: Base grey level, speed, wave amplitude, the two wave frequencies and whether the pointer interacts are props. The metal shading itself is fixed.
weight_why: Every pixel runs a nine-sample loop with ten wave iterations, each frame.

a11y.note: Decorative and always in motion, with no reduced-motion check for the constant flowing surface.

polish_why: Convincing polished metal with rich folds; pure-white highlights clip with no colour.
